title: Digital Dance Mix Vol. 1: Namie Amuro
native_title: デジタル・ダンス・ミックス Ｖｏｌ．１ ～安室奈美恵～
overview:
Japanese pop singer Namie Amuro performs on your Sega Saturn as a digital dancer. Pick "Chase the Chance" or "You're My Sunshine", choose one of five stages and six costumes, and direct the show yourself - move and zoom the camera, lock it onto part of the dancer, and change the speed of the song.

Sing along in a karaoke mode with on-screen lyrics and lowered vocals, stopping and rewinding to practice. A collection of extras adds a rhythm game where you press buttons in time with the music, a card-matching memory game, a door-building puzzle and a maze where you guide a monkey to Namie, along with her profile and discography.

- Digital Dance, Sing It and Presents modes
- For 1 or 2 players
- Memory backup support
